scope: Derived representative-point coverage audit from the two frozen NOAA CUSP packages intersecting the Puerto Rico discovery bbox

derivation.rule: polygonization is discovery geometry only; CUSP contains shoreline and alongshore manifestations and can also include river/lake/canal linework

interpretation.no_negative_evidence: polygon noncontainment is not evidence that a named feature is absent; tiny rocks, reefs, source representative-point offsets, line topology, and non-polygon feature representations remain plausible
interpretation.geometry_representation: the current model must support POINT and LINE-supported manifestations in addition to POLYGON; requiring every GNIS Island-class identity to have a polygon is rejected
interpretation.identity: zero canonical identities are promoted by this audit
